explanations.2: Hopper was born in New York City in 1906, not London.
explanations.5: COBOL came from a committee Hopper advised; no one invented it single-handedly, and not in 1952.
explanations.7: The destroyer USS Hopper is real, but it was named for her in the 1990s, not 1971.
explanations.9: There is no Nobel Prize in Computer Science.
